name: Oyayubihime
source:
The protagonist of the story

Thumbelina (Oyayubihime) is a beautiful little girl with a very short history of misfortune. Due to her small natural body and beautiful features, she is often described as being like a doll. Her life begins to go awry when she is kidnapped on her 16th birthday.

[Translated from [url=https://banbanzai.webnode.jp/character/]official website's character page[/url]]
